name: WARNING: Hidden Valley Ranch Dry Seasoning Mix (Pure Garlic, Onion & Buttermilk Concentrate)
whyItWorks: A concentrated bomb of dehydrated garlic powder, onion powder, dried buttermilk, MSG, and maltodextrin. Frequently used to dust potatoes, pretzels, or chicken, triggering severe gas and osmotic diarrhea.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Avoid commercial dry ranch packets. Make homemade gut-safe ranch using lactose-free Greek yogurt, mayonnaise, fresh dill, and chives.
